The '''''Infiltrator''-series long-range fighter''',<ref name="Rule of Two" /> also referred to as simply the '''''Infiltrator'' series fighter''', was a model of long-range [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] manufactured by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> One such [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the [[Mystic (starfighter)|''Mystic'']], was in the possession of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].<ref name="Rule of Two" /> It was produced after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Infiltrator''-series long-range fighter appeared in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Rule of Two" />
